% Pages of a PDF included with pdfpages, with a lastpage hint of 3 for a
% PDF of 4 pages: every page, and a range to the last page. test/run.mjs
% also builds this page without shell escape, as with --contain, where the
% number of pages is not read and the hint gives it, so the last page is 3.
% With shell escape, the number read overrides the hint, as pdflatex does,
% and the last page is 4. Each run starts with a paragraph "Run name."
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pdfpages}
\begin{document}
Run dash.
\includepdf[pages=-,lastpage=3]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run last.
\includepdf[pages={2-last},lastpage=3]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run end.
\end{document}
